title: Seni bina maklumat dan navigasi laman web
text:
Design the information architecture for a {website_type} serving {audience}.
Available content and offers: {content_inventory}. Primary conversion: {primary_conversion}. Maximum preferred primary-nav items: {navigation_limit}.
Create a sitemap and navigation hierarchy that helps first-time visitors discover the right page with minimal confusion. Group pages by user intent, propose descriptive navigation labels, define parent-child relationships, and identify the best path from the homepage to the primary conversion. Distinguish required pages from optional future pages.
Output a tree-style sitemap, a page inventory with page purpose and unique content angle, recommended header/footer navigation, an internal-linking plan, and mobile navigation behavior. Flag duplicate or overlapping pages. Do not add pages only to target more keywords; every page needs a distinct audience need.
qa: Teks prompt dikekalkan seperti yang dibekalkan. Keberkesanan pada model AI belum diuji.
